items.informal_name: Existence of a Subset in the Powerset for Non-Archimedean Seminorm Inequality
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] {F : Type u_2} {α : Type u_3}
  {β : Type u_4} [inst_3 : CommRing α] [inst_4 : FunLike F α R] [AddGroupSeminormClass F α R] {f : F},
  IsNonarchimedean ⇑f →
    ∀ (s : Finset β) (b : β → α) (m : ℕ),
      ∃ u, f (∑ t ∈ Finset.powersetCard (s.card - m) s, ∏ i ∈ t, -b i) ≤ f (∏ i ∈ ↑u, -b i)
items.informal_description: Let $ R $ be a strict ordered ring, $ \alpha $ a commutative ring, and $ f : \alpha \to R $ a non-Archimedean seminorm (satisfying $ f(a + b) \leq \max(f(a), f(b)) $). For any finite set $ s $, function $ b : \beta \to \alpha $, and natural number $ m $, there exists a subset $ u \subseteq s $ of cardinality $ |s| - m $ such that the seminorm of the sum over all $ (|s| - m) $-element subsets $ t \subseteq s $ of the product $ \prod_{i \in t} (-b(i)) $ is bounded above by $ f\left(\prod_{i \in u} (-b(i))\right) $. Formally, $$ f\left(\sum_{t \in \binom{s}{|s| - m}} \prod_{i \in t} (-b(i))\right) \leq f\left(\prod_{i \in u} (-b(i))\right). $$

items.type:
{ι : Type uι} →
  [Fintype ι] →
    {𝕜 : Type u𝕜} →
      [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] →
        {E : ι → Type uE} → [(i : ι) → SeminormedAddCommGroup (E i)] → FreeAddMonoid (𝕜 × ((i : ι) → E i)) → ℝ
items.informal_description: The function maps a finite formal sum $ p $ of pairs $ (k, f) $, where $ k $ is a scalar in a nontrivially normed field $ \mathbb{K} $ and $ f $ is a tuple of vectors in normed spaces $ E_i $, to the sum over all summands of $ \|k\| $ multiplied by the product of $ \|f_i\| $ for each component $ i $. This defines an auxiliary seminorm used in the projective tensor product construction.

items.informal_description: For any natural number $ n $ and complex polynomial $ p $, the norm of the coefficient of $ X^n $ in $ p $ satisfies $ \|p.coeff\,n\| \leq \binom{d}{n} \cdot p.mahlerMeasure $, where $ d $ denotes the natural degree of $ p $.

items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : SeminormedRing R] → Polynomial R → ℕ → ℝ
items.informal_description: For a polynomial $ p $ over a seminormed ring $ R $, this function returns a sequence indexed by $ \mathbb{N} $ where each term is defined as $ \|p_n\|^{1/(d - n)} $ if $ n < d $, and $ 0 $ otherwise. Here, $ p_n $ denotes the coefficient of $ X^n $ in $ p $, $ d $ is the natural degree of $ p $, and $ \|\cdot\| $ is the seminorm on $ R $. This sequence captures the normed coefficients' growth rates relative to their distance from the polynomial's degree.

items.informal_name: Upper Bound for Descending Pochhammer Symbol in Terms of Binomial Coefficients
items.type:
∀ {n : ℕ},
  n ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {ι : Type u_2} {t : Finset ι} (p : ι → ℕ) (w : ι → ℝ),
      (∀ i ∈ t, 0 ≤ w i) →
        ∑ i ∈ t, w i = 1 →
          ↑n - 1 ≤ ∑ i ∈ t, w i * ↑(p i) →
            Polynomial.eval (∑ i ∈ t, w i * ↑(p i)) (descPochhammer ℝ n) / ↑n.factorial ≤
              ∑ i ∈ t, w i * ↑((p i).choose n)
items.informal_description: For any non-zero natural number $n$, finite set $t$, non-negative real weights $w_i$ summing to 1, and natural numbers $p_i$ such that the weighted average $\sum w_i p_i \geq n - 1$, the descending Pochhammer symbol evaluated at the weighted average $\sum w_i p_i$ divided by $n!$ is less than or equal to the weighted sum of binomial coefficients $\sum w_i \binom{p_i}{n}$.

items.informal_name: Sum over Product of Intervals in a Z-Lattice with Negative Exponent Inequality
items.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  {L : Submodule ℤ E} [inst_3 : DiscreteTopology ↥L] {ι : Type u_3} [inst_4 : Fintype ι] [inst_5 : DecidableEq ι]
  (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ ↥L) {d : ℕ},
  d = Fintype.card ι →
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
      ∀ r < -↑d,
        ∑ p ∈ Fintype.piFinset fun x => Finset.Icc (-↑n) ↑n, ‖∑ i, p i • b i‖ ^ r ≤
          2 * ↑d * 3 ^ (d - 1) * ZLattice.normBound b ^ r * ∑' (k : ℕ), ↑k ^ (↑d - 1 + r)
items.informal_description: For a finite index type $\iota$ with cardinality $d$, a $\mathbb{Z}$-basis $b$ of the lattice $L$, and real number $r < -d$, the sum over all tuples $p$ in the product of integer intervals $[-n, n]$ (for each $\iota$) of the norm of $\sum_i p_i \cdot b_i$ raised to the power $r$ is bounded by $2d \cdot 3^{d-1} \cdot (\varepsilon_b)^r \cdot \sum_{k \in \mathbb{N}} k^{d-1 + r}$, where $\varepsilon_b$ is the norm bound associated with the basis $b$.

items.informal_name: Gauss Norm Upper Bound for Coefficient Terms
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : FunLike F R ℝ] (v : F) {c : ℝ} (p : Polynomial R)
  [ZeroHomClass F R ℝ] [NonnegHomClass F R ℝ], 0 ≤ c → ∀ (i : ℕ), v (p.coeff i) * c ^ i ≤ Polynomial.gaussNorm v c p
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ p $ over a semiring $ R $, valuation $ v $ (preserving zero and non-negative), non-negative real number $ c $, and natural number $ i $, the product $ v(a_i) \cdot c^i $ (where $ a_i $ is the coefficient of $ X^i $ in $ p $) satisfies $ v(a_i) \cdot c^i \leq \|p\|_{v,c} $, where $ \|p\|_{v,c} $ denotes the Gauss norm of $ p $ with respect to $ v $ and $ c $.

items.informal_name: Projective Seminorm Auxiliary Function is Subadditive
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type uι} [inst : Fintype ι] {𝕜 : Type u𝕜} [inst_1 : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : ι → Type uE}
  [inst_2 : (i : ι) → SeminormedAddCommGroup (E i)] (p q : FreeAddMonoid (𝕜 × ((i : ι) → E i))),
  PiTensorProduct.projectiveSeminormAux (p + q) ≤
    PiTensorProduct.projectiveSeminormAux p + PiTensorProduct.projectiveSeminormAux q
items.informal_description: For any elements $ p $ and $ q $ in the free additive monoid generated by $ \mathbb{K} \times \prod_i E_i $, the projective seminorm auxiliary function satisfies $ \pi_{\text{aux}}(p + q) \leq \pi_{\text{aux}}(p) + \pi_{\text{aux}}(q) $.

items.informal_description: The function computes a degree bound for Chevalley's theorem by taking $k + n$ and a function that adds 1 to the count of each natural number obtained from mapping $\text{Fin.val}$ over the multiset $d$ of type $\text{Fin} \, m$. This constructs a degree bound used in the proof of Chevalley's theorem for multivariate polynomial recursions.

items.informal_name: Numerical Bound for Chevalley's Theorem in Multivariate Polynomials with Multiset Counts
items.type: ℕ → (m : ℕ) → ℕ → Multiset (Fin m) → ℕ
items.informal_description: A function that computes a numerical bound used in the context of Chevalley's theorem for multivariate polynomials. It takes natural numbers $k$, $m$, $n$ and a multiset $d$ of elements of type $\text{Fin}\, m$, and returns a natural number obtained by applying the multivariate polynomial bound function to $k + n$ and a function that counts the occurrences of each element in the multiset $d$ after mapping each element to its value in $\mathbb{N}$, then adding 1.

items.informal_name: Degree Bound for Hasse Derivative of Polynomials
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) p).natDegree ≤ p.natDegree - n
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ p $ over a semiring $ R $ and any natural number $ n $, the natural degree of the $ n $-th Hasse derivative of $ p $ satisfies $ \deg(D^{(n)}(p)) \leq \deg(p) - n $, where $ D^{(n)} $ denotes the Hasse derivative of order $ n $.

items.informal_name: Recursive Successor Formula for Degree Bound in Chevalley's Theorem
items.type:
∀ (k : ℕ) (D : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ),
  ChevalleyThm.MvPolynomialC.degBound k D (n + 1) =
    ChevalleyThm.MvPolynomialC.numBound k D (n + 1) ^ ChevalleyThm.MvPolynomialC.numBound k D (n + 1) *
      ChevalleyThm.MvPolynomialC.degBound k D n
items.informal_description: For natural numbers $k$, $D$, and $n$, the degree bound $\operatorname{degBound}(k, D, n+1)$ satisfies the recursive relation $\operatorname{degBound}(k, D, n+1) = \operatorname{numBound}(k, D, n+1)^{\operatorname{numBound}(k, D, n+1)} \cdot \operatorname{degBound}(k, D, n)$, where $\operatorname{numBound}$ computes numerical bounds for multivariate polynomials in the context of Chevalley's theorem.

items.informal_name: Hasse Derivative of Order k on Polynomial Ring
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : Semiring R] → ℕ → Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R
items.informal_description: For a semiring $ R $, the Hasse derivative of order $ k $ is an $ R $-linear map $ D^{(k)} : R[X] 	o R[X] $ defined by $ D^{(k)}(a_i X^i) =  inom{i}{k} a_i X^{i - k} $ on monomials and extended linearly. This operation generalizes the usual derivative by scaling each coefficient $ a_i $ by the binomial coefficient $  inom{i}{k} $ and reducing the degree by $ k $.

items.informal_name: Coefficient Bound for Monic Polynomials with Bounded Roots
items.type:
∀ {F : Type u_3} {K : Type u_4} [inst : CommRing F] [inst_1 : NormedField K] {p : Polynomial F} {f : F →+* K} {B : ℝ}
  (i : ℕ),
  p.Monic →
    (Polynomial.map f p).Splits →
      (∀ z ∈ (Polynomial.map f p).roots, ‖z‖ ≤ B) →
        ‖(Polynomial.map f p).coeff i‖ ≤ B ^ (p.natDegree - i) * ↑(p.natDegree.choose i)
items.informal_description: Let $ p $ be a monic polynomial over a field $ F $, and let $ f : F \to K $ be a ring homomorphism to a normed field $ K $. If the polynomial $ p $ splits over $ K $ and all roots $ z $ of $ f(p) $ satisfy $ \|z\| \leq B $, then for every $ i \in \mathbb{N} $, the coefficient of $ X^i $ in $ f(p) $ satisfies $ \|\text{coeff}_{f(p)}(i)\| \leq B^{\deg(p) - i} \cdot \binom{\deg(p)}{i} $, where $ \deg(p) $ denotes the natural degree of $ p $.

items.informal_name: Cardinality Bound for Integer Polynomials with Bounded Mahler Measure and Degree
items.type:
∀ (n : ℕ) (B : NNReal),
  {p | p.natDegree ≤ n ∧ (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℂ) p).mahlerMeasure ≤ ↑B}.ncard ≤
    ∏ i, (2 * ⌊↑(n.choose ↑i) * B⌋₊ + 1)
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ n $ and non-negative real number $ B $, the number of integer polynomials $ p $ with natural degree at most $ n $ and Mahler measure $ \mathcal{M}(p) \leq B $ is at most the product over $ i = 0 $ to $ n $ of $ 2 \left\lfloor \binom{n}{i} B \right\rfloor + 1 $.
